impact.text: Permanent loss of access to user funds via unclaimable/un-cancelable requests

precondition_sources.text: An approved operator or the owner submits the requestDeposit() or requestRedeem() call.
The submitted request uses controller == address(0).
Assets or shares are available to be pulled into the vault for the request.

intent_sources.text: Request entry points must validate that controller is non-zero so that created requests remain claimable or cancelable by an authenticated caller.
